title: AMFR combined scores
shortDescription: Model combined scores for E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase AMFR.

experiment.title: AMFR combined scores
experiment.shortDescription: Model combined scores for E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase AMFR.
experiment.abstractText: This study measured the digestion of E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase AMFR protein variants with both trypsin and chymotripsin to measure the effect of these variants on folding. The target accession used in the original study is 2LVN.pdb.
experiment.methodText: The score column is the dG value calculated using the coupled model, calculated from the counts across replicates and proteases. dG values were fit directly using a Bayesian model, assuming that each sequence has a shared dG value that is shared across both proteases. Removed 222 variants that failed validation.

title: AMFR chymotrypsin digestion
shortDescription: Chymotrypsin digestion of E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase AMFR.

experiment.title: AMFR trypsin digestion
experiment.shortDescription: Trypsin digestion of E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase AMFR.
experiment.abstractText: This study measured the digestion of E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase AMFR protein variants with trypsin to measure the effect of these variants on folding. The target accession used in the original study is 2LVN.pdb.
experiment.methodText: Sequences were reverse-transcribed and codon optimized using E. coli codon frequencies. Oligo libraries containing mutations were purchased from Agilent or Twist. The libraries were transcribed and translated using cDNA display such that proteins are attached to the cDNA at the C-terminus and have a PA tag at the N-terminus. The protein-cDNA complexes were purified and subjected to a protease assay such that only undigested molecules would retain the PA tag and the cDNA linkage. High-throughput Illumina sequencing was used to quantify the amount of each variant after the assay.
